messages:
Hannah M: hey all :wave: I'm Hannah, joining Eng infra today. excited to be here. quick Qs: 1) my laptop says 'provisioning' — anyone know expected time? 2) I haven't received the GitHub org invite. 3) who do I ping for VPN/access to staging? Fun fact: I used to brew sourdough.

Devon (People Ops): welcome Hannah!! :tada: laptop usually ships next-day; provisioning can take 24–48h once imaged. Tracking: 1Z9999 (sent). I'll follow up on the GH invite now.

Jon (Eng): hey Hannah — welcome. ping me if you need repo access. I'll add you to team infra and the `infra-maintainers` team. what's your GH username?

Hannah M: @Jon it's hannahm-dev. thanks!

Samira (Mentor): hi Hannah — I'll set up a 30m sync for tomorrow to run through local dev + our infra flows. Also, quick VPN note: use Okta VPN and then `ssh` to jumpbox. If you need a jumpbox account, @Cara can help.

Cara (IT): Hi @Hannah M — I don't see a jumpbox account yet. I'll create one today. Can you paste the output of `ssh -V` if you can run it? If not, no worries.

Hannah M: thanks @Cara — running now: `OpenSSH_8.9p1, LibreSSL 2.8.3`.

Devon (People Ops): GitHub invite sent to hannah+redwood@example.com. Accept and then set up 2FA. Also here's the onboarding checklist: https://redwood.example/onboarding (internal link).

Jon (Eng): one tiny dotfile tip — we use `~/.ssh/config` entries like:
```
Host jump-redwood
  HostName jump.redwood.internal
  User hannah
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
```
Drop that in and you can `ssh jump-redwood`.

Hannah M: perfect — thanks everyone. small fun fact: I once lived on a sailboat for 6 months. excited to meet y'all in person sometime! :boat:

WelcomeBot: Reminder: complete HR forms by EOD Friday. :white_check_mark:

Samira (Mentor): welcome again! Lunch Thursday? We'll do a small team welcome — optional but encouraged. :bento:
